about: Guest information for the free hotel list cards of the boards (js/hotel-list-card.js) and the full list in the phone app (app.html). Facts only: name, street address, phone, website, the logo where an official one reads on the cream column. No prices, no offers. Every field keeps the source it was read from and whether it was verified.
runtime: fids-current/data/hotels/yyg.json is made from this file by scripts/hotels/build-runtime.js: only the hotels that are listed and only the fields the cards and the phone app read. Edit this file, then run the script; tests/hotel-list-cards.test.js holds the two to agree.

rules.areas: downtown = within about 2 km of the centre point; airport = within about 5 km of the airport point; resort = a destination resort (resort true) more than 30 km from both points, listed with its drive distance (no tolerance); nearby = the rest within about 30 km of either point. Each about-limit has a 10 % tolerance; downtown is tested first, then airport.
rules.listed: listed false = held back (the reason is given). A listed hotel is shown only while its season is open (season.year_round, or a season.open range that holds the date at the airport).
rules.shuttle: shuttle.mark true only where the shuttle is verified on the hotel's or the airport's own page.
rules.logo: logo.file is loaded through , never inlined; opaque = the file has its own light ground (shown with a multiply blend on the cream column so the box does not show).
rules.logo_fill: logo.fill true = a stacked lockup whose words are small at the common logo height (62 px at 1680x1050): it may take the whole cell of the cream column, the width of the column and the height of its line. The file is shown as it is.

board_point.note: About 1 km from the terminal. Every hotel falls in the same area from either point (distance_km.airport_board_point is kept for the check).

centre.note: YYG has no entry in DOWNTOWN_COORDS in fids-core.js (checked on main today). Suggested entry: 'YYG': { lat: 46.2353, lng: -63.1296, name: 'Charlottetown' }.

verified_legend.verified=true: read on the hotel’s own site, the Tourism PEI listing or the airport’s own site on the checked date (OpenStreetMap for coordinates)
verified_legend.verified=false: from a search index, a travel directory or OpenStreetMap address data only, or not found: the note says which; to be confirmed

notes.brand_sites_note: Marriott, Hilton, IHG and Choice pages answer 403 to automated readers (checked again today: hiexpress.com, marriott.com, choicehotels.com, hilton.com). Those hotels rest on the Tourism PEI listing; their postal codes come from a search index and are marked unverified. Discover Charlottetown (discovercharlottetown.com) shows a bot check: not used, not bypassed.
notes.shuttle_note: Charlottetown Airport, 2026-11-16: "At this time, there are no operating hotel shuttles." So no Charlottetown hotel carries the "Airport shuttle | Navette aéroport" mark. Recheck each refresh: the page says "at this time".
notes.season_note: Judged for Monday 16 November 2026. Tourism PEI prints with its dates: dates of operation may vary, contact the operator to confirm. Where a hotel’s own site states its season, that wins.
sources: Tourism PEI accommodation listings (tourismpei.com/where-to-stay/...), with provincial licence numbers and dates of operation
OpenStreetMap via Overpass and Nominatim (ODbL): credit "© OpenStreetMap contributors"
OSRM public router on OpenStreetMap roads, for the resort drive distances
Search index (travel directories quoting brand pages): only for postal codes of brand hotels, marked verified=false
notes.not_listed: Summerside hotels (about 60 km, not resorts) are outside the Charlottetown cards. Cavendish lodging is cottages and motels, all closed for the season (see hotels_excluded).

foot_mark_option.note: Moncton cards carry Destination Moncton-Dieppe and #ExploreNB. The Charlottetown equivalent found earlier is Tourism PEI’s own mark (not yet approved for the cards).
